title: [Perf] Avoid pageable HtoD transfer in MinTokensLogitsProcessor (#29826)

image.wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2025-12-03 > 2025-12-02); picked by gen_tasks.py from PyPI upload dates.

workload.note: MinTokensLogitsProcessor.apply on [64, 151936] fp32 logits with 64 pending min_tokens requests; baseline = pageable HtoD scalar copy (device sync), PR's solution = index_put_ with a device scalar. Wall-clock us, alone and right after an async filler kernel. PR gives nsys traces only (up to 30% TPOT at low concurrency), no numbers.

policy.one_run_is: one `docker run` of the workload cmd per arm per repeat (same image, arm tree swapped in by the prelude)

contention_gate.rules: wait while another tenant uses the GPU (>5 % util or a foreign compute process >1 GiB) or the CPU (load1 > nproc/2)

policy.machine_snapshot: machine.py snapshot per workload run -> data/pr_<n>/work/machine_<arm>_<i>.json

arm_isolation.tree: wipe the wheel's vllm/*.py, copy the arm's vllm/ over site-packages (compiled .so stay)
arm_isolation.files: overlay ONLY task.json:source_files from the arm over the wheel's own tree
arm_isolation.tests_benchmarks: copied from the PR's merge tree to /t without a sibling vllm/ package

policy.noise_model: measure.py: paired log-speedup, MAD sigma, theta = clip(k*sigma, theta_min, theta_max) with k/theta from config.yaml:measure

headline: min_tokens_apply

reported.gain_evidence: At low concurrencies, this leads to a significant (up to 30%) increase in TPOT when including min_tokens in the request.
reported.experiments_note: reported = numbers from the PR body (author's machine)

author_hardware_args.text: The `MinTokensLogitsProcessor` introduces a pageable HtoD transfer here: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/342c4f147266e7d01a8a6a64754df7e0f7f8991a/vllm/v1/sample/logits_processor/builtin.py#L232. This is problematic, since it is sy

standalone.run_baseline: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_29826:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=baseline vllm-task:29826 -lc 'A=/base; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.run_pr_solution: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_29826:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=pr_solution vllm-task:29826 -lc 'A=/gold; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.note: The image already holds both trees (/base = baseline commit, /gold = the PR's merge commit); the one-liner swaps the chosen tree over the installed wheel exactly like run_one.sh's prelude, then runs the workload cmd from /t (the merge tree's tests/ + benchmarks/).

test_note: perf-only (sync removal); no test in the diff; existing logits-processor tests cover correctness.
